shared: Spiders hide under Lids, unseen and untouchable, then spring with a free strike; staying hidden grows them.
differ: What opens a Lid: a neighbour dying, each spider's own trigger, or a countdown of enemy attacks.

takes.label: Ambush beside the bait
takes.line: Every hider shares one tripwire: the unit beside it dying. So seating is the puzzle: bait beside ambushers, gaps around growers.
takes.look_if: a placement puzzle built on neighbours, bait and gaps.

takes.label: Everyone starts hidden
takes.line: Every Lodge card, support too, starts each fight hidden, each with its own wake-up event; other tribes' units stand in the open.
takes.look_if: your whole tribe behind closed doors, each with its own key.

takes.label: Countdown trapdoors
takes.line: You flip units face down while shopping, each with a countdown of enemy attacks; one top card springs copies straight from hand.
takes.look_if: to dial each ambush's timing yourself, and fight with cards in hand.
